title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
notes: highball-db: DXMT and D3DMetal crash after the Bethesda logo, DXVK works well.
GameToMac runs it with DXMT 0.72 + two patches; the crash when opening the map is a known DXMT bug.

knownIssues.symptom: The engine's own DXVK (Kegworks v1.10.4) crashes at launch in D3D11 games that use pipeline-statistics queries (GamePort lab, M1, Heaven: 10 s).
knownIssues.cause: MoltenVK does not support VK_QUERY_TYPE_PIPELINE_STATISTICS; DXVK then resets the query pool it could not create and winevulkan aborts. Whether this game uses the query is not verified.
knownIssues.fix: GamePort's DXVK patch (Patches/dxvk, Scripts/build-dxvk.sh) makes these queries return zero and fixes the crash; Heaven D3D11 ran 5 minutes without crashing in the lab. The patched DXVK is not shipped with the engine yet. highball-db says DXMT crashes in this game, so DXVK is the default.
